content: Jisas nato Jerusalem taꞌe kiŋ
Ŋupe ŋaiye Jisas nenge lenge jetalah kin ya jere sehei me Jerusalem nal moi Betfage topoꞌe Betani ŋaiye seheiye hwate Olip pe, kin nember lenge jetalah kin hoi yal yer.
Kin ŋana lenge hindi na, “Pa hindi yi yoto moi uku ŋaiye yip hindi bep yal yetekeꞌe. Ŋupe ŋaiye pa hindi yi yoto moi uku pe, hwihwaiye pa hindi yetekeꞌe donki
Ŋaiye miyeꞌ ende ka isilih yip tuꞌe leꞌe, ‘Detale ti yip hindi yende ŋai taꞌe liki?’ Pe pa hindi yinime tuꞌe leꞌe, ‘Lahmborenge da ende wah ende ti, ka plihe ember ot hwihwaiye.’”
Tinge yal pe, tinge yetekeꞌe donki mbwahe ende gan seheiye ŋahwikin ŋaiye tinge si yupwaiꞌe seheiye kohmap pe, tinge yumbuse.
O lenge miyeꞌ syeꞌ ŋaiye jan uku yisilih lenge hindi na, “Yip hindi yumbuse donki liki yala yende ŋaimune?”
Tinge yana lenge miyeꞌ uku jande wusyep ŋaiye Jisas si ŋana lenge hindi pe, lenge miyeꞌ uku yana lenge hindi na, “Yambaꞌe donki luku yenge yil.”
Tinge yambaꞌe donki luku yenge yatme Jisas pe, tinge yikil temhroŋ ya yanah hlaꞌ me donki pe, Jisas nanah narp.
Pe lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge wula wula yungwau temhroŋ tinge yanah ŋahwikin ko, syeꞌ yember lou lombo ŋaiye tinge si yotombo yal wah yanar ŋahwikin.
Taꞌe luku pe, lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye yal yer, topoꞌe ŋaiye jan tat yahraꞌe yanange na,

content.text: Got ŋende miꞌmiꞌ me miyeꞌ uku
ŋaiye kin nate ŋoto naŋ tikin Lahmborenge.
Ŋoih miꞌmiꞌ me lemame tikin mwan poi Dewit ŋaiye nat.
Hriphrip topoꞌe yahraꞌe naŋ tikin Got ŋaiye nanah hlaꞌ supule.”

content: Jisas nate gere Jerusalem pe, kin nato yukoh yirise bep nalꞌe nalꞌe ŋetekeꞌe ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lalme, kom ŋau si na gah miꞌe pe, kin nenge lenge jetalah 12 kin yal Betani.
Jisas ŋihyele lou ŋip ŋaiye yukur teŋei lousep
Nyermbe ŋaiye tinge yasme Betani yat pe, Jisas ŋasande nimbot.
Kin nat sikirp wohe pe, kin bep nal ŋetekeꞌe lou ŋip
ŋaiye lou tup sekete. Taꞌe luku pe, kin nala gin sehei etekeꞌe na, lousep syeꞌ teŋei, lakai pakai? Ŋupe ŋaiye kin nat sehei pe, kin ŋetekeꞌe tup ilyehme. O yukur ŋup kin ŋaiye ka teŋei esep.
Pe kin ŋaname lou ŋip uku na, “Yukur na plihe teŋei esep no, lenge miyeꞌ ka yono, pakai!” Pe lenge jetalah tikin si yisande wusyep ŋaiye kin ŋanange.
Jisas ginyenme lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye yende windau yarp yoto yukoh yirise

Ŋupe ŋaiye tinge plihe yate jere Jerusalem pe, Jisas nato yukoh yirise ginyenme lenge miyeꞌ ŋaiye yende windau me ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe yarp uku. Kin ŋahraꞌe hendeinge lenge miyeꞌ nuruꞌe ŋaiye tinge yende wah wuhyau, topoꞌe luh lenge miyeꞌ ŋaiye tinge yarp yende windau me jesumbihnip.
Topoꞌe kin syep erŋeme lenge ŋaiye yukur ka yenge ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe tetehei tikin windau plihe yoto tus yukoh yirise.

Taꞌe luku pe, kin ŋana lenge na, “Yainge sai na gah Tup tikin Got ŋanange taꞌe leꞌe, ‘Yukoh ŋam, ka yukoh ŋaiye mitiŋ lalme moiye moiye ka yute juhilyeh yininge wusyep topoꞌme Yai.’ Kom yip si yende taꞌe yukoh tase lenge miyeꞌ endei.”

Lenge pris ondoh topoꞌe lenge miyeꞌ sande tekeꞌe tikin wusyep erŋeme yisande wusyep uku pe, tinge yahaiꞌe yaŋah ŋaiye ka yonombe Jisas ka ole. Kom tinge hiꞌjarnge. Detale, lenge mitiŋ lalme ŋaiye yisande sande tekeꞌe ŋaiye kin nalaŋatme pe, tinge gunguru plai.
O sehei nala ŋup Jisas nenge lenge jetalah kin yasme Jerusalem yal.
Miyeꞌ ŋaiye ŋoihmbwaip kin ka teŋei bongol me Jisas no, ka isilihme Got pe, se ka ambaꞌe
Nyermbe hondo hondonge ŋaiye tinge yal pe, tinge yetekeꞌe lou ŋip uku ŋaiye misei Jisas ŋihyele pe, lou uku si ŋahraꞌe telei lalme, topoꞌe lou nam si telei lalme.
Pe Pita ŋoih bwar wusyep uku ŋaiye Jisas ŋanange pe, kin ŋaname Jisas na, “Jetmam, bep el! Lou ŋip uku ŋaiye ni ŋihyele pe, si ŋahraꞌe telei miꞌe ko.”
Taꞌe luku pe, Jisas nungwisme wusyep tinge na, “Ŋoihmbwaip yip ka teŋeime Got.

Ŋam mana yip bwore mise, ŋaiye miyeꞌ ende ŋoihmbwaip kin yukur hoihoi no, ka inime hwate leꞌe, ‘Na tuhur papalai el guh loh pinip’ pe, luku se ka ende gunde tuꞌe luku. Ŋaiye miyeꞌ uku ŋoihmbwaip kin ka teŋei bongol supule pe, ŋai uku se ka ende tuꞌe ŋaiye kin ŋanange.
Taꞌe luku pe, ŋam mana yip, ŋaiye pa yisilihme Got me ŋainde no, ŋoihmbwaip yip ka teŋei bongol me ŋam pe, se pa yambaꞌe.

Topoꞌe ŋupe ŋaiye yip yanange wusyep topoꞌme Got no, yip ŋoiheryembe lahmende ŋaiye si ŋende pupwa me yip pe, yusme pupwa kin uku. Ŋaiye pa yende tuꞌe luku pe, Yai yip ŋaiye narp nanah moihlaꞌ kin topoꞌe ka osme pupwa yip.”
Tinge yisilihme Jisas ŋaiye lahmende nalaŋatme kin
Jisas nenge lenge jetalah kin plihe yate jere Jerusalem pe, kin nange na ŋoto yukoh yirise. Pe lenge pris ondoh, miyeꞌ sande tekeꞌe tikin wusyep erŋeme topoꞌe lenge miyeꞌ embep yatme kin.
Pe tinge yisilihme kin na, “Nin nambaꞌe wutuꞌ iki, topoꞌe bongol iki ŋanarai ti, ni ŋende ŋai taꞌe liki? Lahmende nalaŋatme nin ŋaiye na ende wah iki?”
Jisas nungwisme wusyep tinge na, “Ŋam topoꞌe, ŋam de misilih yip ŋisilih ende. Ŋaiye pa yungwisme ŋisilih ŋam pe, ŋam topoꞌe se ma mini yip lahmende ŋaiye pwale bongol eꞌe no, ŋam mende wah uku.
Jon ŋaiye gihyeꞌe pinip lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge pe, yip ŋoihyeryembe na, luku ŋai tikin moihlaꞌ lakai, ŋai tikin miyeꞌ ilyeh me? Yip yungwisme wusyep ŋam.”
Pe tinge yanange yale yat tititinge na, “Ŋaiye ya mininge na, ŋai tikin moihlaꞌ pe, kin se ka ininge na, ‘Pe detaꞌe lai ŋaiye ŋoihmbwaip yip yukur ka teŋeime kin?’
Kom tatame ŋaiye ya mininge na, luku tikin miyeꞌ? Liki yukur tatame.” Detale, tinge hiꞌjarnge ŋoihmbwaip nihe lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye tinge ŋoiheryembe nange Jon kin profet bwore mise.
Taꞌe luku pe, tinge yungwisme wusyep Jisas na, “Poi yukur sisyeme.” Pe Jisas plihe ŋana lenge na, “Ŋam topoꞌe yukur ma se plihe mini yip lahmende ŋaiye pwale wutuꞌ eꞌe no, ŋam mende wah bongol uku.”

footnotes.text: 11.13 Mak nainge pe, lou fik, kom poi member lou ŋip.
11.26 Miyeꞌ sande tekeꞌe syeꞌ ŋoiheryembe nange wusyep rop syeꞌ uku sai nato ves 26. Ŋaiye yukur yip yasme pupwa lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge pe, Yai yip ŋaiye narp nanah moihlaꞌ yukur ka se osme pupwa yip.
